name: bloom-portfolio
description: Bloom Portfolio — plantilla gratuita de portfolio, una iniciativa de Qodira. Tu trabajo merece ser visto.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .ssr && node scripts/prerender.js
scripts.build:editor: vite build -c vite.runtime.config.ts && vite build -c vite.editor.config.ts
scripts.build:editor:qodira: vite build -c vite.runtime.config.ts && BLOOM_EDITOR_BASE=/bloom-editor/ vite build -c vite.editor.config.ts && rm -rf ../project-landing-page-QODIRA/public/bloom-editor && cp -R dist-editor ../project-landing-page-QODIRA/public/bloom-editor
